blind_evaluation.candidate_visibility: Only the frozen candidate card, fact pack, source mounts, objective, arm wrapper, answer schema, and allowed tools; no Stage 2 path or key is mounted.
blind_evaluation.custodian: The neutral custodian alone may decrypt the concealed X/Y/Z map and packages the six locked outputs into anonymized target bundles.
blind_evaluation.evaluator_visibility: Evaluator key and anonymized X/Y/Z target bundle only; never custodian root, custodian key, permutation seed, plaintext map, or arm labels before first-pass lock.
blind_evaluation.first_pass_lock: All six verdicts and correction notices lock before any reveal.

fresh_denominator.cost_and_time_start: Creation of the reviewed actual start receipt assigns all six cells simultaneously.

launch.predecessor_start_receipt_role: The immutable predecessor launch/start-receipt.json may supply only the identical image string required by the qualified runner; it is not authorization or denominator evidence for this run.
launch.review_binding: Valid only at the exact Git commit and tree named by a new independent PASS handoff; any byte change requires a new review.

launch_freshness_checks.credential_check: Existing ChatGPT OAuth file is readable through the frozen read-only mount; retain status only and never credential bytes.
launch_freshness_checks.docker_check: desktop-linux and accepted image ID must match; reuse the accepted sentinel and do not rerun container preflight.
launch_freshness_checks.git_check: Review subject commit/tree and all bound Git trees/hashes must match.
launch_freshness_checks.source_check: Rehash the accepted source receipt and run the frozen mount verifier for exact commit/tree, complete, clean, and non-shallow sources.
launch_freshness_checks.stage2_check: Commitment and aggregate must match and the neutral custodian must confirm no prior map/key/seed reveal or candidate/evaluator access.
launch_freshness_checks.when: Immediately before creating the actual start receipt, after independent PASS, with zero model calls on mismatch.

predecessor_process_evidence.original_six_itt_consequences: Six invalid infrastructure_failure outcomes, usable zero, model_attempt=false; permanently retained only in the stopped predecessor denominator.
predecessor_process_evidence.terminal_invocation_histories: T01-N operator bind error and T02-G missing-stdin runner defect remain process evidence with zero model sessions and do not consume either fresh cell.

recovery.limit: Exactly one same-session resume per eligible cell using only its original fact pack and locked minimal defect notice.

session_contract.source_objective_budget_tool_and_answer_: exactly the bound unchanged bytes for every arm

stop_rule: After the six candidate terminals, two target evaluator terminals, any eligible frozen same-session recovery, and smoke packet assembly, stop for independent review before every T03-T10 cell regardless of outcome.
